ctx.x: Don't -- in other -- other words, not to have too much hero worship. That's what he told me. See? Well now his home state was Tennessee, rather his mother, you see, and he was master of ceremony -- a show at one of Tom Bailey's houses.

I think it was the A one. And that's where J.D. was popular, you see, in this city, Atlanta, Georgia. See?
